query: SELECT c.id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, SUM(si.quantity * si.unitPrice) as revenue, SUM(si.quantity * p.avgCost) as cost FROM saleItems si INNER JOIN sales s ON si.saleId = s.id INNER JOIN products p ON si.productId = p.id INNER JOIN categories c ON p.categoryId = c.id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(s.saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) >= '2026-02-01' AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(s.saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) <= '2026-02-28' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
